description: Define the manifest-level backup contract for scenarios and resources. The design should default backup behavior from canonical storage classes and resource dependency types, specify when config/data/state/cache/logs are included or excluded, and define the minimal declarative override mechanism for true exceptions. The outcome must explicitly forbid hardcoded per-scenario and per-resource branches inside data-backup-manager itself.
name: backup-contract-defaults-and-exceptions-design
title: Design backup defaults and exception contracts
